meta.title: ATOMSTAR · IT Consulting and Adversarial Research
meta.description: Atomstar runs infrastructure, identity and continuity for Quebec businesses, then attacks it to see what holds. Penetration testing, vulnerability research and AI agent security.
meta.ogTitle: ATOMSTAR — IT Consulting and Adversarial Research
meta.ogDescription: We run your infrastructure and we attack it. Penetration testing, vulnerability research and AI agent security.

hero.sub: IT consulting, infrastructure, and offensive security.

consulting.title: IT Consulting.
consulting.lede: We design and run the systems your business depends on.

cards.title: Infrastructure as code.
cards.body: We define your infrastructure in a repository. You review each change before it ships, and you can rebuild the whole estate from scratch.

cards.title: Identity and access.
cards.body: We run your directory, your devices and the keys behind them. You get documentation that matches what we built.

cards.title: Network and continuity.
cards.body: We design the network and we prove the backups restore. One dead site should not stop the business.

offensive.title: Offensive Security.
offensive.lede: We attack what you ship and what you rely on.

cards.title: Vulnerability research.
cards.body: We find bugs in other people's software and report them through coordinated disclosure. Six of ours carry a CVE, going back to 2019.

cards.title: Penetration testing.
cards.body: We attack your web, cloud and internal systems. You get findings you can reproduce yourself, and we re-test once you have fixed them.

cards.title: AI and agent security.
cards.body: We try to make your language models and agents misbehave, through prompt injection and tool misuse, then show you which guardrails gave way.
